# Paramahansa Yogananda: “The Teachings Will Be the Guru”

### Sri Mrinalini Mata • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving blessings. Many disciples feel a sense of regret that they cannot physically walk beside the Guru. But our Master Paramahansa Yogananda gave us this magnificent assurance: "The teachings will be the Guru." The relationship between Guru and disciple is eternal and entirely spiritual, transcending time and space.

### Connecting With the Living Guru

When we study the SRF Lessons with deep attention and apply their truths to our daily lives, we are in direct communion with Master. The Guru is not a physical body; he is the cosmic consciousness that speaks through these sacred pages. Every time you practice your lessons with devotion, his spiritual presence envelops you.

### The Power of Sacred Study

Do not rush through your readings. Absorb each sentence, letting the wisdom penetrate your soul. This daily connection is the most direct way to establish perfect attunement with his protective grace.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Lesson Study:** Set aside fifteen minutes daily to read and absorb the SRF teachings.
* **Keep Master Close:** Place a picture of the Guru on your altar and talk to him in the language of your heart.
* **Practice Faithfully:** Know that you honor the Guru most by practicing his scientific methods of meditation.
* **Serve Selflessly:** Cooperate in his work to spread peace and light to all seekers.

Jai Guru! Jai Maharaj!
